name: Dead Code Candidates
method: Reference search over app/, routes/, tests/, database/, config/ and bootstrap/, cross-checked against `php artisan list` for framework-registered commands and against routes/console.php for the scheduler. A class with zero source references is NOT dead if the framework can reach it by convention.
critical_finding: 3 scheduled console commands (rewards:expire, bookings:expire-pending, currency:sync-rates) have zero source-code references and are still live. A purely lexical dead-code scan would have deleted three running scheduled jobs. All candidates were therefore validated against `php artisan list` before any deletion.
